cells.name: F-11 secondary press
cells.line: pressed: held true engaged 2 contextmenu 1 · released: held true engaged 2 contextmenu 1 · after a primary click elsewhere: held true engaged 2 contextmenu 1

cells.name: F-11 contextmenu ends a pointer hold
cells.line: pressed: held true engaged 2 contextmenu 0 · contextmenu, button still down: held true engaged 2 contextmenu 1 · after the release: held false engaged 0 contextmenu 1

cells.name: F-11 control-click
cells.line: Control + primary press: held true engaged 2 contextmenu 1 · after release: held true engaged 2 contextmenu 1

cells.name: F-11 touch long press
cells.line: +200 ms: held true engaged 2 contextmenu 0 · +1500 ms: held true engaged 2 contextmenu 0 · 300 ms after the touch ends: held false engaged 0 contextmenu 0
